rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone you work or do an activity with, including a business partner.

example.english: They are my partner for playing football.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 tek3 bo1 ge3 paak3 dong3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a formal or professional collaboration, especially in business contexts.

example.english: Our company has become a long-term business partner with that Japanese company.
example.traditional: 我哋公司同日本嗰間公司成為長期合作夥伴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 tung4 jat6 bun2 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 wai4 coeng4 kei4 hap6 zok3 fo2 bun6
